What Are These Atlantic & Cape May, NJ Communities Best Known For?
Atlantic City, New Jersey is best known for being the casino mecca of The East.
Atlantic City is also the home of many other great firsts, such as the first boardwalk in American history on June 26, 1870.
Pictured here is Resorts Casino Hotel Atlantic City, which became the first casino in New Jersey/Atlantic City. when it opened on May 26, 1978.
Ventnor City, New Jersey was established on March 17, 1903.
It's a great down beach community where our family lived for more than 30 years.
Pictured here is the iconic fishing pier.
Ventnor is also known for it's great beaches and the home of the world famous Van Duyne lifeguard boat, which is the standard in the lifeguarding.
Margate City, New Jersey was first incorporated on September 7, 1885, initially known as the Borough of South Atlantic City.
It was reincorporated on April 23, 1897 as a City and finally on April 20, 1909 as Margate City.
It was named after Margate in Kent, England.

There are many wonderful attributes of this great city, however, we have selected "Lucy The Elephant" as the most recognizable landmark of Margate City. "Lucy" was built in 1871 and stands six-stories high.
It is considered to be the oldest roadside attraction in the United States.
It's also a registered historic landmark.
Cape May City, New Jersey is well known for its historic homes, mansions, hotels and restaurants.
Pictured above is the fabulous La Mer Beachfront Resort.
Owned by The Andy Family, it opened in 1969 in the heart of Cape May City.
Over the years, it has dramatically expanded, now including opulent suites and a waterfront restaurant right by the Atlantic Ocean.
Longport, New Jersey is known for many high quality things, such as beautiful homes and residential flavor.
We have selected its most recognizable fixture to be the Longport Water Tower, which they have painted with a smiley face and "Longport is The Best Port" over the years.

We have selected a beautiful painting by the talented and collectable local artist, Jon Baker, which depicts both The Longport Water Tower and Lucy The Elephant ... who is visiting from neighboring Margate City, New Jersey.
Several other icons and a lovely Pageant Queen are also featured in this Baker original painting.
Ocean City, New Jersey was first incorporated as a Borough on May 3, 1887.
It became Ocean City as we know it on March 25, 1897.
It was named after its location next to the Atlantic Ocean.
Ocean City is self-marketed with the motto, "America's Greatest Family Resort.
Pictured here is the fabulous Ocean City Music Pier.
This is the home of great live music and other special events.
Millville, New Jersey was established by an act of the New Jersey State Legislature in 1866.
Millville is known as "The Holly City," because of the many Holly trees that were cultivated at the former Holly Farm in East Millville.
The Millville Army Airfield Museum (home of the P-47 Thunderbolt) is also fantastic, along with parks, lakes and wildlife areas.
Millville is also famous for future Major League Baseball Hall of Famer Mike Trout and the fabulous Levoy Theater, pictured here.
The history of Mays Landing is just incredible.
Peter Steelman is believed to be its first resident in 1710, long before The United States of America was established.
It was named after Captain George May, who sailed the Great Egg Harbor River in 1740.
Charles Cain is the Mayor.
The Cain's are 7th generation residents of Hamilton Township/Mays Landing.
Mays Landing.
You can swim, kayak, boat and scuba dive at Lake Lenape at designated areas.
There are also recreation areas and playgrounds.
We have selected the former, iconic Atlantic City Race Course as a recognizable landmark in Mays Landing.
It opened in 1946 and operated until 2015.
Show business legends Frank Sinatra, Bob Hope, Harry James and Xavier Cugat were original shareholders.
Pictured here is the annual Harry Hurley Annual race that took place for a number of years until the Atlantic City Race Course closed in 2015.
Another fun fact: Part of the 1964 Alfred Hitchcock iconic movie thriller "Marnie" was shot at the Atlantic City Race Course.
Wildwood, New Jersey was first incorporated as a Borough on May 1, 1895.
It was previously part of Middle Township.
The Wildwoods focused on becoming destination resort in the late 19th century.
Wildwood became a city on January 1, 1912.

Wildwood has a rich history in music, as Bill Haley & The Comets performed on Memorial Day Weekend in 1954 and played "Rock Around The Clock" ... considered by many to be one of the first rock and roll hits in American history.
Dick Clark would also bring American Bandstand to Wildwood.
Wildwood is also very famous for its boardwalk and amusement piers, pictured here.
Last, but not least, is one of my favorite places in Atlantic County, New Jersey ...
The Historic Towne of Smithville, New Jersey.
It all began with an Inn, that is still located on and operated along Route 9 in Galloway Township, New Jersey.
The Inn, (picture here) was built in 1787 by a local developer names James Baremore.
It is now owned and operated by The Coppola Family, where Tony Coppola is presently the Mayor of Galloway Township.
The Historic Towne of Smithville, New Jersey actually predates the inauguration of George Washington as President of The United States by 2 years.
Capriccio Italian Restaurant is the # 1 Casino Restaurant in America for the past 3 consecutive years and 4 out of the past 5 years.
This coveted title is awarded by USA Today 10Best Readers Choice Awards.
Pictured here is their best meal ... "Vitello (Veal) Romero," an amazing creation that was developed by Jorge Romero, the beloved decades-long General Manager of Capriccio Italian Restaurant.
Jorge passed away on Monday, February 15, 2021 and is missed by family, friends and colleagues.
Don't miss visiting this great restaurant, it's the finest finest restaurant in Atlantic City and in all of America.
Vic & Anthony's Steakhouse at the Golden Nugget Hotel & Casino in Atlantic City, New Jersey is the finest steakhouse in The World's Play Ground.
We consulted with General Manager Sal Spena and here is what he submitted as the best meal available at his fabulous restaurant.
This is their Prime Bone-In Ribeye, weighing in at a whopping 22 ounces.
Bring your appetite.
Harry Hurley, TSM.
Steve & Cookies by The Bay in Margate is an exceptional restaurant, owned by Cookie Till.
This was an easy selection for us.
I selected my and Kristin Hurley Baker's favorite meal.
Pictured is the incomparable Seafood Pan Roast.
It consists of a lobster tail, 2 shrimp, 2 scallops and a wonderful portion of colossal crab meat.
It literally consists of our absolute seafood favorites all at one time.
It is always prepared to perfection and the portions are very generous.
Spoil yourself with this wonderful meal, which we believe is Steve & Cookies best!
Alan Angeloni photo.
Alan Angeloni has owned and operated this local, legendary restaurant for the past 42 years.
The entire menu is fabulous, however, the Braciole is the best in Atlantic City.
It's Alan Angeloni's interpretation of this thinly sliced meat that is rolled into what is known as a roulade.
It's also called involtini in Italian.
Angeloni uses veal and not flank steak, beef, pork, chicken or even swordfish that others turn to.
It makes Angeloni's unique and the best.
Try it, soon.
Harry Hurley, TSM.
Dock's Oyster House is an upscale seafood restaurant that has thrived since 1897.
It's an elegant dining experience.
We selected the seafood tower.
It is both an awesome presentation and it can serve as a wonderful meal or appetizer.
It generously consists of: Lobster Tail, Colossal Shrimp (that should have their own zip code), Colossal crab meat (my favorite), along with raw Oysters and Clams.
You're welcome!
Smithville Inn is located in historic Smithville, New Jersey.
Owned and operated by The Coppola Family.
The original Smithville Inn was bult in 1787 by James Baremore.
That's before America's first President George Washington was sworn into office on April 30, 1789.
That's amazing.
This is The Smithville Inn's Chicken Pot Pie.
It is prepared and looks like it was baked in 1787.
This is a classic dish and my favorite on their menu.
It's warm, savory and satisfying.
It's always an absolute delight when you get a bite with their wonderful dumplings, which are hidden inside.
This is II Mulino New York at The Hard Rock Casino Hotel in Atlantic City, New Jersey.
II Mulino is a consistently high performer and is currently rabked as the # 2 best casino restaurant in America, as voted by USA Today 10Best Readers Choice awards.
They make the most delicious Ravioli in town.
For National Ravioli Day, they made an amazing Porcini Ravioli in Champagne Truffle Cream Sauce.
Look at their homemade Ravioli during the preparation stage.
Another Dougherty Family of fine restaurants has made our coveted list.
The Knife & Fork Inn open in Atlantic City in 1912.
They feature steaks, chops and seafood.
Close your eyes and any item on the menu that your finger lands on will be a winner.
We have selected their Herb-Crusted Rack of Lamb ... with Vidalia-Chipolte Bordelaise and Rosemary-Sage Potatoes.
You're very welcome!
This is Amada at Ocean Resort Casino in Atlantic City, New Jersey.
Amada is one of 3 Atlantic City Casino restaurants that have made the (Top 10) coveted USA Today 10Best Readers Choice Awards, which are awarded to the finest casino restaurants in America.
Amada is currently ranked as the # 10 best casino restaurant in America.
Amada features Spanish cuisine.
Picture here is their grilled octopus.
Harry Hurley, TSM.
The Crab Trap is one of my favorite restaurants.
This wonderful seafood restaurant was established in 1967.
Their menu is extensive.
We have chosen some of our favorites.
The Crab Bisque soup is the finest that you will find anywhere.
It's pictured here.
Their mini crab bites are also fabulous.
Also pictured is their stewed tomatoes dish.
The most delicious I've ever had anywhere.
